We take this opportunity to introduce ourselves – M/s.GANESH INC.
Dedicated to serving Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical and Nutraceutical companies in South India in
areas of Starch and Starch Derivative Products, Specialty Ingredients and Hygiene Monitoring Systems.
A brief Profile of our Proprietary Firm is given below.
PROFILE AND PRODUCTS:
GANESH INC. has been in the business of Flavours, Food ingredients and commodity chemicals for more
than 12 years.
We have been a supply/service-oriented company catering to our customers across the different verticals
and segments of Food Industry and Nutraceuticals. Quality and consistency remain our strongest forte in
the industry, and excellent track record with our clientele has proved our commitment towards customer
satisfaction. We have represented more than a couple of International Companies including Du-Pont
Danisco (Denmark based MNC) for flavours and food ingredients, as well as popular Indian companies for
commodity chemicals and specialty ingredients. We continue to provide our customers with world class
Quality food ingredients and flavours from esteemed Multinational companies.
Our current product portfolio comprises of:
1. GUJARAT AMBUJA EXPORTS LTD - Starch derivatives which include Liquid Glucose,
Maltodextrin, Maize Starch, Dextrose Monohydrate, Dextrose Anhydrous and Sorbitol [70%
solution], Xylitol, Malitol.
2. DÖEHLER (German MNC) -Food, Beverage, Confectionary and Alcoholic Flavours,
Concentrates, fruit crushes and pulps.
3. AKRAS FLAVOURS & FRAGRANCES: wide range of premium fragrances & flavours
catering to Customer specific requirements.
4. CAMPCO - Cocoa Powder and Industrial chocolate based products such as Chocolate Slabs,
Chocó Chips, Chocó Paste and Chocolate Dip.
5. Mane KANCOR : Specialty Food Ingredient Solutions Company supplying natural extracts,
oleoresins, etc..
6. OXYCURV CHEMICALS- Commissioned and Established in Jan 2021 under “Make in
India” initiative for manufacture of Sodium Percarbonate at Hubli, Karnataka.
